book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Mak kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨp dam Pailod mɨdeia ud arla

Hilɨm halö, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau löm, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau löm, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau löm, Juda Kansol bɨ kub gau magöŋhalö löm, magöŋhalö manö hag gum göm, Jisas nɨp nagɨ löm, dam gapman bɨ kub Pailod mɨdeia u ud arla.
Dam arlö, Pailod Jisas nɨp haga, “Ne Juda nɨbi bɨ kiŋ kale u aka?” ga. Hageia, Jisas haga, “Me ne hagpan me u,” a ga.
Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau Jisas manö kub hagöm manö ke ke iru nöp hagla.
Anɨg gö, Pailod Jisas nɨp haga, “Nöp manö iru hagaböl u, ne pen manö rɨmnap hagagnabön ar?” a ga.
Hagö, Jisas pen manö hagagö, Pailod gasɨ iru yabɨƚ nöp nɨŋa.
Juda nɨbi bɨ gau hagla, “Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmön!” a gɨla
Pen Juda kai Pasopa ñɨn kub u auö, pör am Rom gapman bɨ kub Pailod nɨp hag nɨŋlö, kalɨp bɨ nagɨman kale hag nɨŋmɨdal bɨ u nöp yɨharɨŋ hag höŋ yumɨdöp.
Pen ñɨn anɨbu, bɨ ap hib nɨpe Barabas nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap ugalöm, Rom gapman aip pen pen göm, wip al pak lɨla rö, kalɨp nagɨ lɨlö mɨdeila.
Nɨbi bɨ gau ap magum göm, Pailod nɨp bɨ nagɨman pör hag nɨŋmɨdal rö hag nɨŋlö,
Pailod kalɨp haga, “Juda kiŋ kub kale u, kalöp hubɨk yunam aka?” ga.
Nɨhön gɨnɨg: Pailod nɨpe ke nɨŋa, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau, Jisas nɨp yɨharɨŋ mulu kal nɨŋla rö, nɨp dap ñɨla.

Pen bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hagla, “Pailod nɨp hagpe, Jisas wasö, Barabas nɨp hubɨk yunɨm,” a gɨla. Anɨg gɨlö, nɨbi bɨ gau Pailod nɨp hagla, “Barabas nɨp hanɨp hubɨk yumön,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, Pailod haga, “Anɨg hagpim u, pen bɨ anɨbi kale Juda kiŋ hon a gɨpim u, nɨp nɨhön gɨnam?” ö ga.
Hagö, kale manö bƚaƚö göm hagla, “Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmön!” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pailod haga, “Nɨpe nɨhön gɨ naij gö, anɨg gɨnam?” ö ga. Anɨg hageia pen kale bƚaƚö yabɨƚ göm hagla, “Mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmön! Mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmön!” a gɨla.

Pen Pailod, manö kƚö hagla anɨbu udöm, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp aij gaŋ, a göm, Barabas nɨp yɨharɨŋ hag yuöm, bɨ nɨpe rɨmnap kalɨp hagö, Jisas nɨp nagɨ löm, mɨñu magö pakla. Jisas nɨp pak pɨs gɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Pailod haga, “Nɨp dam mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmim,” a ga.
Ami bɨ gau Jisas nɨp hag jula
Ami bɨ gau, Jisas nɨp dam gapna Pailod ram kub nɨpe u amöm, bɨ yam kale rɨmnap kalɨp wɨñ allö aueila,
waƚɨj aɫɨ mɨlöbö ap, gapman bɨ kub gau rol gɨ mɨdmɨdal rö Jisas nɨp rɨm ñöm, nan kalɨ kalɨ halö rɨmnap rɨk dapöm, kiŋ rol gɨpal usajɨl bad rö ap göm, nɨp nabɨc cög adö laŋ rol gɨ ñɨla.
Rol gɨ ñöm, Jisas nɨp aƚeb aƚeb ñöl göm hagla, “Ne Juda kiŋ kub pör nöp mɨdmön!” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, ur udöm, nabɨc nɨpe paköm, nɨp kɨñu al ñɨla. Mɨdeia söl au kugom yɨmöm, kale kiŋ nɨp gɨmɨdal rö, nɨp ubör yɨhöŋ gɨla.
Nɨp anɨg göl hag juöm, waƚɨj aɫɨ mɨlöbö nɨp rɨm ñɨla u ud ju yuöm, waƚɨj nɨpe ke u yɨm ñöm, mab ba laŋ al pak lɨnɨg ud arla.
Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨla

Kale aŋ au amöl gɨ, Aleksada Rupas madöl mɨhau nap kale Saimon, Sairini daun nɨbö bɨ u, gau gɨ ajöm, apöm Jerusalem arnɨg areia u, nɨp nable paköm, kƚö göm, hagla, “Jisas mab kros u ud kag gɨmön ud aru!” a gɨlö, udöm kalɨp aip ara.
Anɨg göl amöm, Jisas nɨp dam ram mɨnöŋ au manö yöl hib Golgoda a gɨmɨdal ka au amjakla. Golgoda manö iƚ u “Wip Nabɨc Cög Ij.”
Amjaköm, nɨp ñɨg wain ap udöm, marasɨn mö a gɨmɨdal rɨmnap ud bɨg ado malo göm, Jisas nɨp ñɨla pen ñɨŋaga.
Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak löm, waƚɨj nɨp gau udöm, nɨme lɨ ke ke udnɨg, sadu rö göl göm udla.
Sɨdö hilɨm halö lɨm gɨ yuöm yöp audɨk galɨk aua magö u, Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ cɨpɨƚ pak lɨla.
Cɨpɨƚ pak löm, nɨhön gɨnɨg al pak lɨla manö u, mab kros ba adö laŋ kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla: JUDA KAI KIŊ KALE ME I.
Mañ anɨbu, bɨ nan si udep mɨhöp u rö nöp al pak lɨla, ap mab böŋ lap, ap mab böŋ lap.
Gɨla anɨbu, God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, gɨnaböl a gɨla rö nöp gɨla. Manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla, “Nɨp nɨŋlö, bɨ nan naij gep ap rö lɨnab,” a gɨla.
Nɨbi bɨ gau ap ran ap lugöl gɨ, Jisas nɨp nɨŋöm, nabɨc gor mar göm, nɨp hag juöm hagla, “Ne, ‘God sabe gep ram u rɨb waƚ gem, ñɨn mɨhöp nɨgaŋ kauyaŋ gɨ lɨnabin,’ a gɨna u,
mɨñi ne ke gɨmön, kamɨŋ arö, hon nɨŋun,” a gɨla.

Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau abe, Jisas nɨp u rö nöp hag juöm, kalɨp ke nöp pen hagö pen hagö göm hagla, “Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp gajɨp kamɨŋ arbal u pen uri nɨp ke gö kamɨŋ arnɨm rö lagöp.

Nɨpe pör hagöp, ‘Isrel nɨbi bɨ Mesaia mɨdpin, Isrel Kiŋ mɨdpin,’ a göp rö, mɨñi nɨp au laŋ cɨpɨƚ pak lɨbal u, nɨpe ke u rö nöp urak aui auö nɨŋun nɨŋö hagöp, a gun, nɨp nɨŋ udnabun,” a gɨla. Pen bɨ Jisas aip al pak lɨla mɨhau Jisas nɨp u rö nöp hag julö.
Jisas uma
Sɨdö aŋ aulɨk aua magö u, sɨbön göm, mɨd damöm, sɨdö gamɨŋ ga magö u kauyaŋ mailö ga.
Mailö gö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas meg mɨgan dap ranöm, wɨñ al hagöm haga, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakdani?” ö ga. Hibru manö haga anɨbu manö iƚ u, “God yad. God yad. Yɨp ai gɨnɨg arö gɨpan?”
Hagö, nɨbi bɨ söl anɨb au mɨdeila gau nɨŋöm hagla, “Nɨŋim! Ilaija nɨp wɨñ alab,” a gɨla.

Pen bɨ ap nan hain auebö rö bad ap udöm, ñɨg wain mani pro raubal mɨgan yaŋ rauöm, Jisas nɨp ñɨnö ñɨŋaŋ, a göm, gamɨƚ mɨlö ap ud abös alöm, mɨdeia adö laŋ ñöl gɨ, haga, “Hon nɨŋ mɨdno, Ilaija apöm, nɨp ud asɨk dam mɨnöŋ iƚ yaŋ lɨnab aka?” ga.
Anɨg hagöm, nɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas wɨñ kub alöm, uma.
Magö anɨbu nöp, waƚɨj mɨlö kub God sabe gep ram magö raul mɨgan yaŋ ajöŋ pɨƚ gɨla u, aŋ u pa bɨƚɨƚɨ göm, ke ke lap lap aram mɨgan hiɨk mɨdeia.
Bɨ ami gau abad mɨdmɨdöp bɨ kub u, mab kros ba aŋ aui adö au gɨlaŋ mɨdeia u, Jisas anɨg hagöm uma u nɨŋöm, nan nɨhön nɨhön ga gau nɨŋöm, haga, “Nɨŋö hagpal! Bɨ anɨbi God Ñɨ nɨpe yabɨƚ!” a ga.

Nɨbi iru nöp Jisas aip Jerusalem aula gau, apöm goƚ au mɨdeila. Aŋ anɨbu, nɨbi mɨhau nɨgaŋ Jisas nɨp wög pro pro rɨmnap gɨ ñɨmɨdal ram mɨnöŋ Galili. Nɨbi Maria mɨhöp mɨdailö; nɨbi hib aƚog anɨb mɨhau, ap Magdala daun nɨbö, ap Jems Josep madöl mɨhau nɨme kale u. Nɨbi ap hib nɨpe Salomi. Nɨbi anɨb gau magöŋhalö nɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas uma.
Josep nɨpe Jisas hañ romaŋ kabö mɨgan au rɨgöl ga

Josep bɨ Arimadia daun nɨbö, Juda Kansol kub bɨ gep ap, God nɨbi bɨ udöm abad mɨdeinab ñɨn anɨbu abad mɨdmɨdöp. Bɨ anɨbu, rol God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u, a göm, nan gɨ jɨn geia. Jisas uma u nɨŋöm, ram söl dugnɨg gab, a göm, mɨñi wip he ud asɨk dam rɨgöl gɨnam, a göm, pɨñɨŋ gaga; Pailod mɨdeia u amöm, hag nɨŋa.
Hag nɨŋö, Pailod, Jisas hadö uma manö u nɨŋöm, pa gɨƚɨ göm, bɨ ami bɨ abad mɨdmɨdöp bɨ kub u nɨp wɨñ alö, aueia, hag nɨŋa.
Hag nɨŋeia haga, “Mɨdönöp umöb,” a ga. Anɨg hagö, Pailod Josep nɨp haga, “Yau. Wip dam rɨgöl gɨmön,” a ga.

Hagö, Josep waƚɨj rud kub ap rauöm, am wip he ud asɨk dap lugöm, waƚɨj u ud magöŋhalö wam wam göm, dam kabö mɨgan gɨsön nɨbö nöp ƚu lɨla kabö mɨgan u rɨgöl ga. Rɨgöl göm, kabö haƚai kub ap ud gau ga gɨ damöm, wip rɨgöl ajöŋ u pɨƚ ga.
Maria Magdala aip, Maria Josep nɨme u aip, nɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, wip rɨgöl gɨla.
